_help: Fill in the values, then run: python3 tools/build.py — every page is regenerated with your details. Leave a value empty to keep the [PLACEHOLDER] text. reviews: add genuine customer reviews with sample set to false (first name, area, project type, rating 1–5, quote). Entries marked sample: true are for the reviews-preview.html layout only and are never rendered on public pages or in Review/AggregateRating JSON-LD (fake reviews are illegal in the UK). Set [GOOGLE_REVIEW_URL] to your public Google review / leave-a-review link.

reviews.quote: They built us a composite deck off the kitchen that copes with the salt air and still looks smart after a winter of Cornish rain.
reviews.name: Sarah

reviews.quote: From the first site visit to the last board, the work was tidy and the hardwood finish is beautiful.
reviews.name: David

reviews.quote: We needed a glass balustrade for a sea-view deck on a steep garden. They designed it so it feels open but safe.
reviews.name: Emma

reviews.quote: Old boards were rotting and slippery. They repaired the frame and replaced the deck in a week.
reviews.name: Tom
